documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: In Q1 FY27, Uniparts India reported a 27% year-on-year increase in revenue from operations to INR 347 crores, driven by strong growth in the construction equipment segment which accounted for 45% of total revenues. EBITDA for the quarter grew 55% year-on-year to INR 90 crores while profit after tax expanded 64% to INR 57 crores. The company maintained a robust balance sheet with net cash standing at INR 190 crores and a trailing 12-month new business order book of over INR 225 crores. Management expects full-year FY27 revenue growth to exceed FY26 growth by a couple of percentage points, supported by Mexico warehouse deliveries starting in Q3 FY27. Uniparts India reported total income of INR 3,552 million for Q1 FY27, recording year-on-year revenue growth of 27%, EBITDA growth of 55%, and PAT growth of 64%.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India expects full-year FY27 revenue growth to be a couple of percentage points higher than the growth achieved in FY26.
guidance.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Q2 FY27 operational performance is expected to remain robust and in line with Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Q2 looks very robust, and I think Q2 should be in line with Q1.

guidance.claim: Mexico warehouse operations are projected to generate mid-single-digit million-dollar revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, we believe that this revenue should be in mid-single-digit million dollar level.

guidance.claim: Uniparts India reported Q1 FY27 performance that aligned with its quarter-on-quarter guidance and exceeded its annual guidance.
guidance.quote: This performance is in line with the quarter on quarter guidance we had shared but better than the annual guidance we had given, and reflects the quality of execution by the team across a quarter that was not without its challenges.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects revenue growth in FY27 to be in line with FY26.
guidance.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

guidance.claim: The company expects Q1 FY27 to be sequentially in line with Q4 FY26 and H2 FY27 to be stronger than H1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Therefore, sequentially, we expect Q1 to be in line with Q4. And overall, we expect second half of FY27 to be stronger than the first half of '27.

guidance.claim: Uniparts expects to operate comfortably above a 20% EBITDA margin level as volumes build through FY27.
guidance.quote: We have said consistently that 20% EBITDA is sustainable over the cycle. And as volumes build through FY27, we expect to operate comfortably above that level.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in construction equipment is being sustained by infrastructure spending in the U.S. and government investments in Europe.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the U.S. and the government-led investments in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs view calendar year 2026 as the cyclical bottom for large agricultural equipment, expecting recovery in calendar year 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that current year 2026 represents the cyclical bottom with a more meaningful recovery expected through calendar year 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Small agricultural equipment in India is performing well, supported by government subsidy programs and increasing adoption in mid-to-higher horsepower categories.
demand_outlook.quote: In the small agriculture equipment, India continues to perform well, supported by government subsidy programs and rising adoption across the mid-to-higher horsepower categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Aftermarket revenue accounted for approximately 12% of total Q1 FY27 revenue and remained flat year-on-year in absolute terms.
demand_outlook.quote: Finally, our aftermarket business represents approximately 12% of revenue in Q1 of FY27 and was flat year-on-year in absolute terms.

demand_outlook.claim: Infrastructure-led spending in the US and Europe is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility in construction equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Infrastructure-led spending, particularly under the technology investments in the US and government led spending in Europe, is sustaining healthy customer schedules and order visibility.

demand_outlook.claim: In Western markets, small agriculture growth remains measured as economic uncertainty has tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: In Western markets, small ag growth remains more measured. Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading OEMs indicate that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom for large agriculture, with recovery expected through CY2027.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading OEMs have indicated that CY2026 represents the cyclical bottom, with a more meaningful recovery expected through CY2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility led to demand skewing in the aftermarket segment as higher prices moderated customer purchasing.
demand_outlook.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

demand_outlook.claim: North American construction equipment demand is expected to continue growing in FY27, with the second half being stronger than the first half.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America, customers' commentary and industry data point to continued growth in FY27 for construction equipment, with demand expected to gradually strengthen through the year and the second half being better than the first half.

demand_outlook.claim: The small agriculture market in North America is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, the segment is poised for approximately 5% growth in FY27, in line with industry estimates.

demand_outlook.claim: European construction equipment market demand showed early signs of recovery in Q4 FY26, with modest growth expected for the full year.
demand_outlook.quote: Specifically coming to Europe, the construction equipment market appears to have passed its cyclical low with early signs of recovery becoming more visible in quarter 4 of '26.

demand_outlook.claim: Large tractor industry volumes in North America continue to decline in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: In North America and particularly, the industry volumes for large tractors continues to track down in the mid-to-high teens year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule without causing customer supply disruption.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse operations are expected to begin in Q3 of this fiscal year.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure during Q1 FY27 was INR 12 crores, focusing on capacity enhancement, productivity, and customer-led initiatives.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital expenditure during the quarter was INR12 crores, in line with ongoing investment plans focused on capacity enhancement, productivity improvement and customer-led growth initiatives.

capex_expansion.claim: Restoration of the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility is progressing on schedule while maintaining uninterrupted customer supply.
capex_expansion.quote: On that note, the restoration of the finishing shop at our Ludhiana facility is progressing well and on schedule, and I am pleased to report that customer supply has remained uninterrupted throughout.

capex_expansion.claim: Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.
capex_expansion.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

capex_expansion.claim: The company continues to invest in growing its construction and large agricultural equipment businesses.
capex_expansion.quote: We are continuing to invest in growing our construction and large agricultural equipment businesses, given that small ag is already a segment where we hold significant global market share.

capex_expansion.claim: Uniparts plans to keep capex steady at 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
capex_expansion.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex stood at INR 12 crores for Q4 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: capex stands at INR12 crores for the quarter and the new business awards were over INR225 crores in annualized potential over last 12 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 reached INR 90 crores, marking a 55% year-on-year growth and 10% sequential growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter was INR90 crores, registering strong 55% growth year-on-year and 10% growth sequentially, reflecting healthy operating leverage and disciplined cost management across the business.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost in Q1 FY27 was 33.3%, primarily reflecting a shift in product mix.
margins_costs.quote: So Viraj, if you look at it, our cost of materials this time is about 33.3%, And I think it's coming at 33.3% largely because there's been a product mix change.

margins_costs.claim: Management maintains that material costs normally range between 34% and 37% over the business cycle.
margins_costs.quote: I think what we've always maintained is that our material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%, and that's typical of our business.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts India remains confident of maintaining a 20% EBITDA margin across the industry cycle.
margins_costs.quote: We are also very confident of maintaining our 20% EBITDA margin over the cycle.

margins_costs.claim: The ongoing West Asia situation exerted pressure on input costs and supply chains during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

margins_costs.claim: Uniparts achieved an EBITDA margin of 24% for Q4 FY26 and 22% for the full year FY26.
margins_costs.quote: A brief on the financial position for quarter 4 FY26, Uniparts delivered an EBITDA margin of 24% and 22% EBITDA margin for the full year FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs stood at 35% in Q4 FY26, returning to the normal range of 34% to 37%.
margins_costs.quote: Now when we look at quarter 4 and let's understand the results of quarter 4, our material cost of 35% has now come back to where we've always said our normal material cost should be in the range of 34% to 37%.

margins_costs.claim: The implementation of the new wage code in November 2025 resulted in a INR 3.4 crore impact on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: This performance actually accounts for INR3.4 crores impact on profitability due to the new wage code introduced in November 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailing 12-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing 12-month new business order book remains robust at over INR225 crores with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Construction equipment business contributed 45% of total revenue in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Ashutosh, you are right that in Q1 FY27, the business has really seen a good growth in the construction business, which is today 45% of our total revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's trailing twelve-month new business order book stands at over INR 225 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: On the business development front, our trailing twelve-month new business order book remains robust at over INR 225 crore, with a healthy pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: Uniparts recorded trailing 12-month new business wins exceeding INR 225 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So if I talk about the strategic outlook, our new business momentum actually has gained meaningful traction with trailing 12-month business wins exceeding INR225 crores, growing over 12.5% over quarter-on-quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company relies on balancing capex when onboarding new business, maintaining overall capex within 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: What this means is that when we get a new business, then at that point in time, we only need to do balancing capex and hence, that capex remains in the range of 2.5% to 3.5% of revenue.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash balance stood at approximately INR 190 crores at the end of Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of quarter 1 stands at INR190 crores, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow generated during Q1 FY27 was INR 44 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR44 crores of operating cash during the quarter, and our 12-month trailing EPS stands at INR39.97, reflecting sustained improvement in earnings over the past year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is actively evaluating about half a dozen acquisition opportunities.
capital_allocation.quote: I think today, we have about half a dozen opportunities that we are closely looking at.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts India ended Q1 with a net cash position of INR 190 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Our net cash position at the end of Q1 stands at INR 190 crore, reflecting the continued strength of our cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared a special dividend of INR 101 crore in October 2025 when its cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: when we declared the special dividend of INR 101cr in October 2025, our cash balance was approximately INR 210 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts continues to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities to accelerate its strategic agenda.
capital_allocation.quote: Our balance sheet is in excellent health, and we continue to actively evaluate acquisition opportunities that can accelerate our strategic agenda.

capital_allocation.claim: Uniparts distributed total dividends of INR 170 crores in FY26, including a special dividend of INR 101 crores declared in Q3.
capital_allocation.quote: During Q3 of FY26, the company declared a special dividend of INR101 crores. In fact, the total dividend distributed for FY26 was INR170 crores, underscoring our commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholders' return.

capital_allocation.claim: The company remains net debt-free with a net cash position of INR 160 crores as of March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The cash flow remains strong, and the company continues to be net debt free with a net cash position of INR160 crores as on March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The special dividend in Q3 FY26 was declared after evaluating an acquisition target and deciding not to proceed.
capital_allocation.quote: The special dividend that we paid out in Q3 of FY26 is partly because we evaluated an opportunity carefully and then decided not to proceed.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical tensions in West Asia continue to exert pressure on supply chains and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ongoing West Asia situation has continued to exert pressure on input costs and supply chains.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility and macroeconomic factors led to demand deferrals and customer purchasing moderation in the aftermarket.
risks_headwinds.quote: The tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: Economic uncertainty and volatility have tempered consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases.
risks_headwinds.quote: Consumer appetite for big-ticket equipment purchases has been tempered by economic uncertainty and volatility, leading to continued deferral of buying decisions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff-driven price volatility caused customers and channel partners to moderate purchasing in the aftermarket segment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tariff-driven price volatility has led to some demand skewing, as higher prices caused customers and channel partners to moderate their purchasing.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fire incident occurred in the finishing shop at the Ludhiana facility during Q3 FY26.
risks_headwinds.quote: As communicated previously, towards the end of quarter 3, one of our facilities in Ludhiana experienced a fire incidents in the finishing shop.

risks_headwinds.claim: A fresh escalation in West Asia introduced supply chain uncertainty and higher input prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the evolving geopolitical situation has resulted in increasing input prices, some of this inflation is being mitigated by favourable exchange rates.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts expects full-year FY27 revenue growth to exceed FY26 growth by a couple of percentage points.
management_commitments.quote: keeping that in mind and the visibility that we have, our FY27 growth will be a couple of percentage points bigger than the growth that we had in FY26 on a year-on-year basis.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse facility are scheduled to start in Q3 of this fiscal year.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3 of this year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the fabrication segment to grow into a meaningful vertical over the next 18 to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: In the next 18 to 24 months, we believe this vertical will be a meaningful vertical.

management_commitments.claim: First customer deliveries from the Mexico warehouse are expected in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: Equally, our Mexico operations are on track, with first customer deliveries from the warehouse expected in Q3.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth in FY27 to match FY26 levels.
management_commitments.quote: Overall, we do expect the growth in FY27 to be in line with what it was in FY26, supported by an improving industry cycle, execution of recent business rewards and wins and a gradual recovery across the end markets.

management_commitments.claim: Uniparts plans to keep capex within 2.5% to 3.5% of total revenue.
management_commitments.quote: Madhur, our capex plans remain unchanged at about 2.5% to 3.5% of our revenue, and that is consistent, and we will not be deviating from there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
